brief:
Script-In-Hand Theatre performed dramatic readings from a book by young Palestinian writers, introducing hundreds of British audience members to the stories, We Are Not Numbers reported. The theatre company presented the work across multiple venues in Britain, bringing the compiled accounts to readers through live performance.

The book features firsthand narratives and perspectives from Palestinian youth on their experiences and daily lives. By staging dramatic readings rather than simple recitations, Script-In-Hand created an accessible format that allowed the writers' voices to reach British audiences in an engaging theatrical context. The performances underscored the personal nature of the collected stories from the young contributors.
dek: Script-In-Hand Theatre introduces hundreds of Britons to the stories of young Palestinian writers.
title: UK theatre group stages readings from Palestinian youth writers' book
